title: A due date shows confidence, Certificate or Calendar, never a figure
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Seed unit 402's reading history by hand (standard steps; Mark complete on a work order records that work order's mileage and engine hours as readings dated its Reset date):
  4. ↳ In Settings > Maintenance (needs Settings Service) create, once, a throwaway schedule "ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed" with one routine service per reading: "ZZ Seed 1", "ZZ Seed 2" (calendar Every 12 months each). Enrol the unit on it (its Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule, dates blank).
  5. ↳ For each reading below, oldest first: Work Orders > New Work Order for the unit; type the mileage (and the engine hours, where given) in the work order's Mileage (and Engine Hours) field; on that work order's maintenance card open the next "ZZ Seed" service's row menu > Mark complete > On a work order (this work order) > Reset date = the date given > Mark complete. A Reset date is never in the future.
  6. ↳ Readings: ZZ Seed 1: Reset date 200 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2: Reset date 20 days before today, Mileage 130,000.
  7. ↳ Then remove the unit from the throwaway schedule (Maintenance tab > schedule menu > Remove from schedule), and enrol it on a schedule "Due check" with PM-A (calendar Every 12 months + Distance Every 15,000 mileage, last service date 200 days before today; overdue by its mileage estimate), CVIP (compliance, Term 12 months) and "Lube" (calendar Every 60 days, date blank). A unit whose past invoiced work orders already carry the same history may be used instead.
  8. On unit 402's asset card add a CVIP record: Term 12 months, End date = 20 days after today (+ Add record, Save).
  9. A second test unit created with Mileage left empty, enrolled with blank dates on a service "NR" (calendar Every 30 days + Distance Every 15,000 mileage).
  10. If Mark complete does not record a seeded reading (the Mileage or Engine Hours card does not show that value and date afterwards), stop: mark this case Blocked and write "seeding failed: Mark complete did not record the reading" in the result comment. That is a separate problem with its own case, not a failure of this one.
custom_steps:
1. Read the area beneath the due date on unit 402's PM-A row (meter, word) and hover the meter.
  2. Read unit 402's CVIP row and Lube row beneath the due date.
  3. Read the second unit's NR row.
  4. Hover the meter icon beside the estimated due month.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A meter-estimated row shows its confidence beneath the date (the meter and a word) with the rule in its hover.
  • A compliance row shows "Certificate" and a calendar row shows "Calendar" instead, never a confidence meter.
  • A meter row with no usable readings shows the calendar date and says which reading is needed (e.g. "Calendar · needs mileage reading") - the majority case, no warning styling.
  • On the design the hover reads "Based on mileage estimate".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (unchanged requirements); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard S1; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R34: “A row whose due date is estimated from a meter shows its confidence beneath the date, the asset tab's meter and word, with the rule in its hover per S11-R9. A compliance row shows Certificate and a calendar row Calendar instead, never a confidence meter; a meter with no usable readings reads Calendar · needs mileage reading”
  • S13-E3: “A row whose meter has no usable readings shows the calendar date and says which reading is needed. This is the majority case and carries no warning styling”
  • Design board, artboard S1 (meter hover): “Based on mileage estimate”
